tax_amount.description: Income tax provision/expense for the target quarter, in DOLLARS (same units as the Q-4 baseline) — NOT a rate. Pretax income is near zero or negative this quarter, which makes an effective tax RATE numerically meaningless (a small pretax swing produces an enormous rate swing). Predict the dollar tax provision directly; sign matters (a tax BENEFIT is negative). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.
